_comment: Mobs of Mythology spawns kobold and kobold_warrior via BiomeContext.hasTag(c:badlands); the mod's Forge-side equivalent for the same field is forge:is_dry, so the intended semantics are 'dry biomes', not strictly mesa. On Fabric c:badlands is populated only by fabric-convention-tags-v1 (nested inside fabric-api) as #c:mesa + #minecraft:is_badlands, and Regions Unexplored joins neither, so zero RU biomes were in it and kobolds could only spawn in the ~25% of Overworld land RU does not own. Added the 7 members of RU's own c:climate_dry tag that are also in minecraft:is_overworld — using RU's own classification rather than guessing. The other 5 climate_dry entries (mycotoxic_undergrowth, blackstone_basin, infernal_holt, glistering_meadow, redstone_abyss) are Nether biomes and were deliberately excluded.
